title: Exact formulations for rectangular-warehouse single-picker routing with scattered storage in single-block and two-block layouts
summary: Order picking travel dominates much of warehouse effort, and exact routing is especially valuable when storage is scattered so pick locations are not fixed in advance. We address the single picker routing problem (SPRP) and its scattered-storage variant (SPRP-SS) in single-block and two-block rectangular warehouses.
